subject: Compliance add-ons & commercial options for MedSys
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medsys.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing for audit logs / HSM seats / US residency

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the demo last week — our security team asked me for numbers so we can position this to procurement. High level asks:

- Audit log export + 7 year retention (read access for auditors)
- KMS/HSM integration (we'll want customer-managed keys; estimate 3 key admins, possibly 6 total users)
- US residency (primary region us-east, no cross-border storage)
- HIPAA addendum & evidence (SOC2 summary, encryption at rest details)

Can you share ballpark pricing and whether you offer bundle discounts if we take both residency + HSM + audit retention? Also tell me if there are any one-time implementation fees for agency/legal review. Procurement asked for a PDF/line-item sheet.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Director, Security & Compliance
MedSys Health
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medsys.com>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing for audit logs / HSM seats / US residency

Hi Elena — great to hear from you. Appreciate the clear list. Below are pragmatic options we commonly propose; attaching a one-page price summary as a PDF for procurement.

Option A (Modular, self-serve):
- Audit logs: $0.08 / GB-month retained (7y retention billed monthly), basic export access included; per-audit export $150.
- KMS/HSM: $450 / seat / month for managed HSM; or $0.12 / 1k HSM key ops if you prefer usage billing.
- Residency: $12,000 / month flat for dedicated regional data partitioning (includes 99.9% residency SLA).
- HIPAA addendum & SOC2 evidence: no recurring fee; one-time compliance onboarding $3,500 (includes review + template AEs).

Option B (Committed / Bundled):
- 12-month commit to hosted spend + compliance bundle: 15% bundled discount across the three items above.
- For commitments >$200k ARR we can move to 25% bundle discount and waive the one-time onboarding fee.

We typically also include a 90-day audit retention trial for Audit logs (no charge) so you can confirm export and access flows. I attached the price summary and a short SOC2 summary.

Would you be available for a procurement-facing call Wednesday to walk the line items?

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_v1.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: MedSys pricing ask — recommended concessions

Michael / Grace — quick internal note on concession strategy for MedSys:

- Keep list prices above, but offer a structured concession: 15% off bundle for 12-month commit; escalate to 22% if they commit to 18-month or provide a minimum ARR guarantee.
- Waive onboarding fee if they sign within 2 weeks of proposal.
- Consider converting HSM to a blended rate (2 seats @ monthly seat + discount for ops) rather than pure usage — procurement prefers predictability.
- If they ask to waive residency fee, require a 2x minimum spend over 12 months.

If we want to be more aggressive, propose 25% off on the condition of a multi-product SOW and DocuSign within 30 days.

-Neha
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medsys.com>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for audit logs / HSM seats / US residency

Elena — thanks for the quick reply earlier. Based on internal alignment (see note from Neha), here is a formalized commercial option for procurement to review. I pasted the line items below for easy copy/paste into your SOW.

Redwood proposal (12-month term):
- Audit log retention (7Y): list $0.08 / GB-month. Estimated 2 TB/month ingested -> $160 / month.
- HSM seats (managed): 3 seats @ $450/seat/month -> $1,350 / month.
- US Residency partitioning: flat $12,000 / month.
- HIPAA addendum + SOC2 evidence: onboarding fee waived for signed SOW within 14 days.
- Bundling concession: 15% off total compliance addon line items for the 12-month term.
- One-time integrations/implementation: $0 (waived) if SOW signed within 14 days; otherwise $4,000.

Approx monthly AND discounted run-rate (estimated):
- Pre-discount: $13,510 / month
- 15% bundle discount: $11,483.50 / month

We can also provide a monthly invoicing schedule and DocuSign package. I've attached the one-page PDF and the SOC2 summary.

Please let me know if procurement would like the 18-month deeper discount option (22%) — that requires an ARR-floor commitment. Happy to jump on a call with procurement this week.

Best,
Michael

Attachment: Redwood_Compliance_Pricing_v1.pdf
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medsys.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for audit logs / HSM seats / US residency

Michael — appreciate the clear breakdown and the waiver offer. Procurement has two quick asks before we can sign:

1) Can you remove the $12k residency line and fold it into the bundle at the 15% discounted run-rate? Procurement dislikes separate flat fees.
2) We need a formal SOC2 report (not just a summary) and a DocuSign-ready SOW with the HIPAA addendum included.

If you can accommodate #1 (fold residency into bundle) and confirm immediate DocuSign access + SOC2 report, we can aim to sign within 10 business days. Otherwise we will need to route to our legal for separate review which adds time.

Thanks — Elena
